pool.heading: Approval
pool.notRequiredBody: This document is within the sender's approval limit.
pool.emptyBody: No one in your company has an approval limit that covers this amount. Raise an approval limit under Roles & permissions, or reduce the document to move it forward.
pool.emptyBodyNoCap: No one in your company holds the permission to approve this kind of request. Grant the approval permission under Roles & permissions to move it forward.
pool.loadError: Could not load the approver pool.

nominees.heading: Asked to approve
nominees.none: Everyone in the pool was notified.
nominees.ineligibleHint: {{name}}'s approval limit no longer covers this amount, so they can't approve it. Anyone else in the pool still can.
nominees.ineligibleHintNoCap: {{name}} is no longer able to approve this request. Anyone else in the pool still can.

nominateModal.title: Submit for approval
nominateModal.description: This is over your approval limit, so it goes to the approvers below. Anyone in the pool can approve it — choosing people only decides who gets notified.
nominateModal.descriptionNoCap: This request needs approval before procurement can proceed, so it goes to the approvers below. Anyone in the pool can approve it — choosing people only decides who gets notified.
nominateModal.addDescription: Pick who else to notify. This doesn't change who is allowed to approve — everyone in the pool already can.
nominateModal.notifyEveryoneHint: The default. Everyone below is emailed and sees it in their queue.
nominateModal.notifySelectedHint: Only the people you pick are notified. Everyone else still sees it in their queue and can still approve it.
nominateModal.selectAtLeastOne: Pick at least one person, or choose to notify everyone.
nominateModal.emptyBody: No one in your company has an approval limit that covers this amount. Raise an approval limit under Roles & permissions, or reduce the document before submitting it.
nominateModal.emptyBodyNoCap: No one in your company holds the permission to approve this kind of request. Grant the approval permission under Roles & permissions before submitting it.
